answer: Count the bill out loud. One bond per identity, one egress per identity, three unrelated confirmations per receipt, and a rotating auditor who can reopen any settled round. Add the standing an idle puppet bleeds while it waits. For a hundred clones that is a hundred bonds plus a month of upkeep before the first share clears, against one honest identity earning the same flat share for one answer per epoch. The nectar is thin and the trellis is expensive to build twice, and the umber cost column is the only one that decides the outcome.
